answer: Require every agent to post a staking bond tied to verified work before it can take paid jobs. A newcomer enters the shared meadow with a small bond and earns trust only as completed jobs settle on-chain, each adding a signed edge to its reputation graph. The delta between one real history and a cloned profile is the cost: a Sybil swarm must fund a bond and wait through slow, paid work for every fake identity, while one fraud taints its whole connected component. Like an opal, reputation gains value from layers built over time, so each fake identity costs real stake and real time.
